issues.title: Fact source binding was a monolithic compile region
issues.before: Public runtime reached before_fact_source_binding and terminalized as PERCEPTION_FACT_SOURCE_BINDING_STALLED without an internal source-binding substage.
issues.resolution: ContractDrivenPerceptionService.compile now exposes generic source-binding stages for source index build, attribute observation projection, evidence ref resolution, evidence set materialization, provenance binding and bound check.

issues.title: Terminal blocked result lacked top-level reason_code
issues.before: R2.13 result endpoint returned blocked, but TaskRunResult.reason_code was null while validation/completion carried PERCEPTION_FACT_SOURCE_BINDING_STALLED.
issues.resolution: TaskRunResult has canonical top-level reason_code and result/session/summary projections prefer that canonical field.

issues.title: Artifact terminalization guard could judge active work by artifact age instead of checkpoint silence
issues.before: A diagnostic public run terminalized while later checkpoints were rejected, showing the worker was still making progress after the guard decision.
issues.resolution: Artifact stall detection now measures silence since the latest artifact checkpoint and preserves existing terminal idempotency.

issues.title: Music inventory reaches persist boundary and stalls before terminal artifact persist
issues.recommendation: H1C0.R2.15 should focus on artifact persist payload-ref/materialization boundary, atomic persist and large artifact manifest behavior.

issues.title: Endpoint-sanitized checkpoint metrics preserve payload size but not all source-binding counters
issues.observed: The final metrics report has payload_ref_count and byte estimates, but several source-binding counters are null after endpoint projection.
issues.recommendation: Preserve bounded aggregate source-binding counters in endpoint-safe projection without inlining facts, evidence records or rows.
